protocol.name: delay_reversal_v1
protocol.status: locally frozen before running these combinations; not external preregistration
protocol.origin: synthetic low-lying B node; not a calibrated mine
protocol.exposure: minimum over all simple B-E routes of maximum trajectory-interpolated water depth, without waiting
protocol.primary_prediction: added passage reduces exposure by at least 0.02 m at departure 0 and increases it by at least 0.02 m at departure 600, in both models
protocol.reporting: all 16 combinations, both model pairs, including failures, opposite signs, shallow differences and numerical warnings; no population probability
protocol.numerical_gates: no negative depth, no roof exceedance (3m), finite residual; SWMM mass error below 1 percent; FV below 1e-6 m3; no reported nonconvergence or flooding loss
protocol.remaining_gates: confirmation is model robustness, not field validation; junction physics, realistic hazard/speed assumptions, related-work novelty and spatial refinement remain separate requirements
